name: pua
tagline_zh: 当代码连续报错、你想摔键盘时，这个技能会先毒舌怼你，再拆解问题——用扎心话术逼你重试，直到你亲手修好它。
tagline_en: When your code fails repeatedly and you're about to quit, this skill roasts you, then breaks down the bug—using.
desc_en: Trae-compatible PUA high-agency governance skill. Use only for explicit PUA requests, repeated failures, user frustration, giving-up/passive behavior, or unverified completion. Do not trigger for normal first-attempt tasks.
why_zh: 它不哄你，而是用“激将法”触发你的好胜心，且只在反复失败时介入，避免烦人。
why_en: It doesn't coddle—it triggers your competitiveness with tough love, and only steps in after repeated failures, so it never nags.
